methodology: POWeR — Plan, Organize, Write, Examine, Revise
core_principle: Writing without meticulous prior planning is a severe waste of corporate resources

customer_centric_language.rule: Customer name appears 3× more frequently than bidder name
customer_centric_language.paragraph_structure: Open with stated benefit to client → follow with technical solution that delivers it

anti_pattern.bad: ECHEM has 25 years of experience in petrochemical manufacturing and has delivered over 200 projects
anti_pattern.good: Your facility will achieve 99.2% uptime reliability — backed by ECHEM's 200-project delivery track record spanning 25 years of continuous petrochemical operations

commitment_verbs.rule: Strong verbs demonstrate binding promise of action. Weak verbs imply lack of definitive commitment.

active_voice.rule: Active voice propels narrative and clarifies accountability
active_voice.bad: The project will be managed by our team of certified professionals
active_voice.good: Our certified project managers will execute every milestone on schedule

seven_sources_of_proof.application: Cite published data supporting methodology effectiveness
seven_sources_of_proof.example: According to PMI's 2024 Pulse of the Profession, organizations using standardized PM frameworks deliver 38% more projects on budget
Achieved 99.7% safety record across 2.3M man-hours on the Alexandria Refinery Expansion

seven_sources_of_proof.application: Detailed narratives of similar-scope project success
seven_sources_of_proof.example: Full case study showing challenge → approach → measurable outcome
Recommended by [Industry Authority] as a best-practice implementation partner
Named quotes with attribution, title, and organization
Awarded 'Best EPC Contractor MENA 2024' by Engineering News-Record

seven_sources_of_proof.application: Rigorous cause-and-effect reasoning when empirical data unavailable
seven_sources_of_proof.example: If-then chains grounded in established engineering principles

fluff_rule: Every adjective on this list is MEANINGLESS unless immediately followed by one of the 7 sources of proof. If no proof exists, DELETE the word.

graphics_rules.principle: Evaluators remember significantly more of what they see in a graphic than what they read
graphics_rules.action_captions: Every graphic MUST have an action caption that explicitly tells the reader what conclusion to draw
graphics_rules.frequency: At least one strategic graphic per major section
graphics_rules.anti_pattern: Never insert a graphic without a caption that drives the evaluator's interpretation

executive_summary_timing: Write early in capture phase — present at initial kickoff meeting as internal compass for all subsequent writers
